measurement_window.scope: source-fenced direct DDS callback counts; missing_before_callback includes source middleware/kernel/network/receiver history; not physical WAN packet loss
measurement_window.age_scope: shared-VM ROS realtime timestamp estimate, rounded up to 1ms; not SRT conservative clock-interval age

command_summary.scope: local Execute invocation to terminal status observation; nominal 200ms poll cadence is not a latency bound; includes service/transport/reconciliation waits; unresolved attempts excluded and counted separately

audit.scope: effect count bounded by distinct intents; UNKNOWN/unresolved may have effects; no nonexecution inferred

command_progress.scope: all attempts, skipped slots and matching closed journal proof; UNKNOWN/unresolved retained; no latency bound, full N5 or transport superiority claim

robot.byte_scope: captured Ethernet-shaped skb lengths; excludes preamble/FCS/physical-link overhead; qdisc/offload interpretation requires explicit environment qualification
